articles.title: Ethereum app builder Consensys has delayed its potential IPO until fall
articles.snippet: The MetaMask wallet builder had reportedly engaged bankers from JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs to lead the process.

articles.title: Crypto wallet provider Ledger puts U.S. IPO plans on hold due to market conditions
articles.snippet: The French crypto security firm, which is said to have explored a potential $4 billion U.S. listing, is reassessing its public market plans as volatile conditions weigh on investor appetite for crypto IPOs.

articles.title: The $82,000 battle: bitcoin tests key resistance zone to form next major breakout
articles.snippet: BTC is fighting a technical battle as it trades just below two closely watched long-term trend indicators: the 200-day Simple Moving Average and the 200-day Exponential Moving Average.

articles.title: Charles Schwab begins U.S. rollout of spot crypto trading for retail customers
articles.snippet: An initial group of clients can now trade bitcoin and ether on the Schwab Crypto platform.

articles.title: Bitcoin to $100K in Q2? Strategy’s STRC unlocks potential to buy 3K BTC in two days
articles.snippet: Strategy’s potential 3,127 BTC buy this week, alongside falling stablecoin dominance, suggests more capital may enter the Bitcoin market.
